days.title: Arrival — sea access at Ölüdeniz
days.summary: Land Dalaman 08:50 local, transfer to Ölüdeniz (~10:50), check-in ~14:00.
tasks: Find and buy gas canisters (EN417/7-16 thread) — see fuel.json, unresolved
Buy dried fruit and other trek food
preTripTasks: Find where to buy gas before arrival
Book a place to stay in Ölüdeniz for the night
days.notes: Ölüdeniz accommodation not yet booked or recorded in accommodation.json — original document flags this as a pre-trip task, not a done deal.

days.title: Ovacık → Faralya → Kabak — sea access by end of day
days.summary: 18.8 km, +807 m per original plan (source: AllTrails, see routes.json for the current-route caveat).
watchOut: Per original notes: regular grocery stores appear absent from Kabak on Google Maps — resupply there is not confirmed.

days.title: Kabak → Alınca — no sea access, start from the coast
days.summary: 6.3 km, +773 m per original plan. No shops or restaurants on the way; a couple of cafés in Alınca.
watchOut: Paradise Beach route variant reported closed by AllTrails (fire closure alert, unverified against OGM directly) — see routes.json variant-paradise-beach.
Steep short day: 773 m ascent over only 6.3 km.

days.title: Alınca → Yediburunlar — inland day
days.notes: No camps/cafés researched yet for this day (blank in original document).

days.title: Yediburunlar → Bel → Patara — sea access by end of day
watchOut: UNRESOLVED: current research suggests this day's real distance/endpoint may differ from the original 16.7 km-to-Patara plan (possible alternatives: Bel, Gavurağılı, Karadere, or Patara/Gelemiş proper). Not yet confirmed — see routes.json notes.

days.title: Patara — Gelemiş — back to Kabak — sea access all day
days.summary: Beach day at Patara, then transfer back toward Kabak.
highlights: Patara Antik Kenti (ancient Lycian ruins), near the camp cluster
watchOut: The dolmuş connection from Adaköy/Gelemiş to Kabak (~45 km) noted in the original plan is UNVERIFIED — see transport.json.
